map.：算法：按体重剂量 = 成人剂量 × (儿童体重 ÷ 成人参考体重)；受限剂量: : Algorithm: weight-based dose = adult dose x (child weight / adult reference weight); capped dose = min(weight-based dose, adult dose x cap multiple); dose ratio = child weight / adult weight x 100%. All values must be >0.

Example 2 (adult 300 mg, child 15 kg, adult 60 kg, cap 1.5x): by weight = 300 x 15/60 = 75.00 mg, capped = min(75, 450) = 75.00 mg, ratio 25.00%.
